name: @mailwoman/neural-weights-de-de
$comment: Data-only overlay. Shares model.onnx + tokenizer.model with @mailwoman/neural-weights-en-us via mailwoman.baseWeights — this package ships ONLY the DE placetype-pair index.

de_artifacts.$comment: Hierarchy campaign R9 (2026-08-02). The German instance of the dependent-locality prior.

pair_index_de_bin.format: PIX1 placetype-pair index — a retrieval-augmented (Ortsteil, Gemeinde) dependent_locality prior, e.g. ("Nippes", "Köln")
pair_index_de_bin.source: Who's On First admin hierarchy ($MAILWOMAN_DATA_ROOT/wof/admin-global-priority.db). Children: borough + neighbourhood (WOF's typing for Ortsteile/Stadtteile). Parents: locality, localadmin, borough. No postal register: Deutsche Post routes 'PLZ Stadt' and carries no Ortsteil field, so WOF is the source — the same call the US instance made and the opposite of France's, where BAN's lieu-dit field IS the postal line.
pair_index_de_bin.$comment_pix2: PIX2 (schema 3, 2026-08-04): every record now carries the PARENT's ComponentTag alongside the child's — +1 byte per pair, pair COUNT unchanged. The recorded parent tag is the WOF parent ROW's placetype projected through PLACETYPE_PROJECTION, so a locality/localadmin parent reads `locality` and a borough parent reads `dependent_locality`. This artifact deliberately ships WITHOUT a `parentDelta`: no board has graded the parent side for this locale, and the D-rule's answer to an unmeasured locale is a per-locale gate rather than a magnitude inherited from us/gb/nz/fr. Absent means the parent bias is OFF here, not zero.
pair_index_de_bin.delta_calibration: δ=10, transitionBeta=5 — inherited from the GB calibration per R5's finding that the classifier's dependent_locality deficit is uniform across locales.
pair_index_de_bin.requires_leading_postcode_strip: This artifact is INERT without the `de` entries in SEGMENT_PARENT_POSTCODE_SHAPES and LEADING_POSTCODE_COUNTRIES (neural/placetype-pair-prior.ts). German addresses write '50733 Köln', so a parent segment folds to a key no bare-Gemeinde entry matches — measured: the index alone changed nothing until both entries landed. Same dependency FR's artifact carries.
pair_index_de_bin.not_committed: derived artifact, .gitignore'd — rebuilt via `mailwoman gazetteer pair-index --out neural-weights-de-de --country de --delta 10 --transition-beta 5 --pairs-jsonl <de-pairs.jsonl>`
pair_index_de_bin.$comment_currency: CURRENCY FILTER (2026-08-02): both ends of every pair are now required LIVE — `is_current != 0 AND is_deprecated = 0`. The WOF ingest hard-rejects `wof:superseded_by` records but RECORDS `edtf:deprecated` and `mz:is_current` as columns rather than rejecting them, so filtering is the reader's job and this extraction was not doing it. Pair count 85605 → 85603.

venue_confound_board.note: 45 directional-class surfaces (Nord/Süd/Ober/Neu…, from 9,406 available) + 25 others, each opening a German venue name

r9_de_ortsteil.fusion_fix: Without the index 'Venloer Str. 300, Ehrenfeld, 50823 Köln' fused the locality as 'Ehrenfeld Köln'; with it the two split correctly.
